sources.description: Standalone full painted rectangle. Older mature near-frontal/three-quarter face toward screen right with raised side gaze, short grey-brown temple hair mostly below a tall navy peaked cap, light grey-brown brows and small closed serious mouth. A single round metal monocle covers screen-left eye only. Cap has high gold bird emblem, lower gold wreath/pale-red roundel, dark band/strap and shiny black visor with gold leaf trim. Navy broad-lapel coat over white pointed shirt and black tie, chest-up crop, soft upper-left illumination on full pale grey-beige painted backing. Tiny upper-lip shading and cap microrelief remain unreadable; no full moustache or second lens is inferred.

Standalone full painted rectangle. Mature face angled toward screen right, very short dark brown-grey temple hair below navy peaked cap, separate brows and tight closed serious mouth; cheeks/chin smooth, tiny upper-lip strip versus skin shadow unresolved. Navy cap with gold upper bird, lower gold wreath/roundel, black strap with small gold fittings and gold leaf visor trim. Navy jacket with pale white-blue pointed shirt and black tie, visible gold shoulder braid at far cropped edges. Retain actual chest-up crop, direction/gaze, upper-left light and complete cream-grey painted backing; precise insignia relief is pixel-limited.

Standalone full painted rectangle. Near-frontal clean-shaven younger face with slight head tilt and gaze toward screen left, short light brown/blond temple hair mostly under tall tilted navy peaked cap, separate light brown eyebrows and small closed serious mouth. Cap retains high gold bird emblem, lower gold wreath/roundel, dark band/strap with small rectangular gold buckle toward screen right, black visor and gold braid/leaf trim. Navy jacket broad lapels over white pointed shirt and black tie; preserve crop, light and full cream-grey painted backing. No monocle, spectacles or beard in this source; tiny cap relief remains unreadable.

Standalone full painted rectangle. Near-frontal mature face with dark full brows, large curled grey moustache and full wavy grey beard covering jaw/chin. Tall black turban has broad burgundy/red diagonal crossed bands at front and a partly top-cropped gold central badge; hair is covered by it. Khaki/brown military jacket with broad lapels, gold shoulder details/round buttons and long gold-decorated shoulder/collar tabs, grey pointed shirt and olive-brown tie. Preserve frontal calm expression, mouth placement between moustache/beard, chest-up crop, soft upper-left light and full pale cream-grey backing; tiny gold badge/insignia linework is pixel-limited.
